purpose: Introduce the circumstances under which instructions apply.
keywords: Plain clause + 場合は; noun + の場合は; な-adjective + な場合は.
If it rains, please gather in the gym.
If you will be late, please call.
If it is inconvenient, let us choose another day.
formation: Plain clause + 場合は; noun + の場合は; な-adjective + な場合は.
restrictions: Often used for contingency instructions or rules.
mistake: Use の after a noun before 場合.
